items.answer: Two pure functions for the Watchlist POC. (1) A notch calculator (REQ-06-02): previous + current rating -> signed notch change, direction and resulting WL. (2) The WL for Indicator 12, country rating change (REQ-03-12). Success: other POC parts import the contract names and get the values the REQ acceptance criteria require, as corrected by C2/C3/C6. E.g. BBB+ -> BB+ gives notches 3, downgrade, WL 2; BBB+ -> BBB- gives notches 2, WL 1; Indicator 12: 1 notch -> WL 1, 2+ notches -> WL 2.

items.answer: Testable once clarifications are applied. REQ-06-02: BBB+ -> BB+ = {notches:3, direction:'downgrade', wl:2}; BBB+ -> BBB- = {notches:2, downgrade, wl:1}; 1-notch downgrade wl 0 (C6); upgrade/unchanged wl 0 (C3); notches signed like notchChange (C5). REQ-03-12: 1-notch downgrade -> 1; 2+ -> 2; upgrade/unchanged -> 0 (C3). Public-source pre-fill out (C4); editability via caller input (C7); 'displayed' via return value (C8).

(a) The REQ-06-02 POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notch downgrade -> WL=1' miscounts: on the C1 scale it is 3 notches. Resolved by C2: BBB+ -> BB+ = 3-notch downgrade -> WL=2; BBB+ -> BBB- = 2 notches -> WL=1. The verbatim POC example must NOT be used as a test case. (b) Calculator thresholds (2 -> 1, 3+ -> 2) differ from Indicator 12 (1 -> 1, 2+ -> 2); intended per C2/C6 (BBB+ -> BBB: calculator wl 0, Indicator 12 wl 1). (c) 'Pre-filled from public source' vs input-only slice: resolved by C4/C7. No unresolved contradiction.

items.answer: src/ratings/notch.mjs: RATING_SCALE = the 19 C1 strings, uppercase, best first (AAA index 0, CCC- index 18). notchChange(previous, current) -> integer index(current)-index(previous): positive downgrade, negative upgrade, 0 unchanged. notchCalculator(previous, current) -> { notches, direction, wl }: notches = notchChange (C5); direction 'downgrade' if >0, 'upgrade' if <0, 'unchanged' if 0; wl 0 for notches <=1 (C3,C6), 1 for exactly 2, 2 for >=3 (C2). src/indicators/countryRating.mjs: countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> 0|1|2: 0 for notchChange <=0 (C3), 1 for exactly 1, 2 for >=2 (REQ-03-12), built on notchChange. Inputs: two positional rating strings, trimmed, case-insensitive (C1).

items.answer: Any input that is not, after trimming and case-folding, one of the 19 C1 ratings throws a RangeError (empty, whitespace-only, 'BBB +', 'CC', 'D', 'NR', unknown strings, non-strings such as null/undefined/123). Applies to either argument of all three functions. No fallback, no null return. Message wording not part of the contract.
